mapper.select: SELECT id, title, content, username, name, start_date AS startDate, end_date AS endDate, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM tasks WHERE username = #{username} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT id, title, content, username, name, start_date AS startDate, end_date AS endDate FROM tasks WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE tasks SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, name = #{name}, start_date = #{startDate}, end_date = #{endDate}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
